content: Close the W0122 provider enumeration-freeze boundary by validating one shared process-view revision at Registry attach, capturing provider initialization revisions for CUDA and NVML, and adding host-independent regressions for frozen membership during an initialization epoch and visibility after a later zero-to-one reinitialization. Preserve the stable shared C ABI and keep physical NVIDIA, Intel, and live qualification outside this stage.

Content revision a2c7a95889f1996246237eb77e1555f4b35d36a9 adds process_view_revision to the client Registry handle, rejects zero or mismatched header/view-control revisions, and records CUDA/NVML initialization snapshots. CUDA/NVML fixtures prove the snapshot remains stable while an attached backing view is changed and captures revision 2 only after a later zero-to-one initialization; runtime fastpath fixtures reject malformed revision metadata.

Focused provider-view regression passed 3/3: integration.runtime-fastpath-registry, unit.provider.cuda-semantics, and unit.provider.nvml-semantics. Full `nix develop .#vulkan-runtime --command ctest --preset vulkan --output-on-failure` passed 91/91. `git diff --check` passed and content Author/Committer are Agent Harness (codex).
